control_families.phone: fieldset legend 'Phone' containing an intl-tel-input country-code combobox (hidden listbox id iti-0__country-listbox, 244 options 'Country +code') and input[type=tel]#phone
control_families.combobox_react_select: input[role=combobox].select__input inside div.select__control; options appear ONLY while open in a portal listbox whose id is react-select-<inputId>-listbox; aria-expanded on the input reflects state; the visible placeholder text is 'Select...'
control_families.file: div[role=group] labelled 'Resume/CV' / 'Cover Letter' with buttons Attach | Dropbox | Google Drive | Enter manually, and a hidden input[type=file]#resume / #cover_letter accept=.pdf,.doc,.docx,.txt,.rtf multiple=false. 'Enter manually' reveals a textarea alternative (not exercised).
control_families.textarea: textarea with id question_<digits> used for free-text custom questions (gh-01: 'Full Home Address*')
control_families.submit: button[type=submit] text 'Submit application' at the bottom of the form

blockers.detail: reCAPTCHA Enterprise anchor iframe (recaptcha.net, invisible/badge style) present on both native samples. Expect a challenge or token check at submit; not triggered.
No login required to view the blank form.
Employer custom yes/no screening questions (work authorization, sponsorship, country/state residency) are required and may be disqualifying.

runtime_observations: react-select menus toggle: a click on an already-focused control closes the menu. Before reading options, verify aria-expanded=true or presence of #react-select-<id>-listbox; if absent, click once more. Reading options requires opening the menu (portal), which is safe and does not commit a value.
The intl-tel-input hidden country listbox (244 entries) is always in the DOM and will pollute naive [role=option] scans; scope to the target combobox's own listbox id.
Custom question ids are numeric and per-employer; labels are the only stable semantic key.

Each employer's custom question set differs in count (gh-01: 4 custom; gh-02: 11 custom) and includes attestation-style questions whose only acceptable answers are consent statements (e.g. privacy notice acknowledgement, 'please double-check' acknowledgement).

typical_stages_unverified: confirmation banner/page 'Thank you for applying' (UNVERIFIED, never visited)
inferred.embedded_hosting_variant_unverified: Many Greenhouse employers embed the same form in an iframe (#grnhse_iframe from boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_app) on their own domain. Not observed in these three samples; the gh_jid sample here was a different vendor. Runtime should detect the iframe and read within it via OpenCLI frames/eval --frame.
inferred.required_marker_inference: A trailing '*' in the label text and aria-required=true co-occur; treat either as required.
inferred.multi_select_inference: Demographic questions worded '(mark all that apply)' are likely multi-select react-select (aria-multiselectable was null in DOM; unverified).
inferred.location_typeahead_inference: 'Location (City)' likely queries an async endpoint as the user types; do not expect a static option list.

provider_hint.for_jev: Greenhouse native form: single page. Map by visible label text, not id. Required = label ends with '*' or aria-required. Combobox options are only readable while the menu is open; the runtime supplies option texts. Custom questions look like question_<digits>; classify each as fact_copy | option_choice | free_text | attestation | eligibility. Stop at 'Submit application'.
exact_copy_facts: full home address (only if a verified address fact exists)
escalate_to_writer_opus: cover letter text if 'Enter manually' is chosen
any textarea custom question that asks for narrative (why this role, describe experience)
requires_human_input: all EEO / demographic / veteran / disability selections (never infer)
attestation acknowledgements (privacy notice, accuracy confirmation) unless the user pre-authorized them
any eligibility question whose truthful answer is not a verified fact

edge_cases: gh_jid URL on employer domain may be a third-party careers site (gh-03) with Rails-style names form_submission[fields_attributes][i][...] and job_questions[<hash>], native <select> lists with an empty first option, checkbox groups for office location, and a separate job-alert signup form that also contains First/Last/Email. A naive 'first email field' mapping would target the job-alert form. Two submit buttons: 'SUBMIT' (job alerts) and 'APPLY' (application). Both are stop boundaries.
gh-03 resume accept list is broader (PDF/DOC/DOCX/RTF/ODT/XML/DOT/PNG/GIF/JPG/JPEG/ZIP per description text) and the file input is required.
gh-03 EEO fields (Veteran Status, Race, Gender) are REQUIRED selects, unlike native Greenhouse where they are optional; 'Decline To Self Identify' is available.
Option text may embed extra tokens (country dial codes) that must not be treated as part of the semantic value.
